accepted_scope: Native SD creation, prospective NICO delivery intents, CRM activity and linked-ticket edit adapters, and explicit prospective parameter grammar.

observations: Opened all six original PNGs. Desktop light and dark cards are legible; mobile390px wraps the long team name and separates search, status and filter buttons vertically without horizontal overlap. Both action links fit inside the mobile card. The mobile captures are intentionally scrolled. Each filter-closed image repeats its same-theme card pixels, so these are not independent opened-dropdown states. Long input text is clipped within its field, not outside the viewport.

Opened all four original saved-editor PNGs. Light and dark surfaces are distinct and readable. The Project card has neutral parameter wording; CRM, Service Desk, notifications and NICO are explicitly pending with disabled controls. Saved-version feedback is visible, while manual per-rule execution is accurately marked pending. Mobile390px cards stack without horizontal overflow. These are scrolled modal captures: the lower warning is partly cropped and no full-form visibility or complete Word conformity is claimed.

Opened six original desktop activation PNGs across both themes. Review requires an explicit checkbox, recorded states show the persisted version, and stale states show a legible revision-conflict message with a return/reload action and disabled activation. No overlapping fields were seen. The server timestamp is still displayed as ISO UTC, a recorded visual/localization gap. Other destinations remain pending; this is not their operational acceptance.

Opened all six original mobile activation PNGs. Review, recorded and stale states are readable in both themes; text and the recorded version wrap within390px. Stale configuration disables activation and shows the reload instruction. Recorded ISO UTC dates remain a localization gap. Stale screenshots are scrolled modal views and the lower reload action is partly outside the captured area; no full viewport visibility is claimed.

Opened six original desktop history PNGs. Both themes show bounded read-only history, distinct failed/pending badges and the warning that reading does not repeat work. Lower history rows extend below these captured viewports, so full visibility of every state is not claimed. Both native Project Task dialogs show loaded IDs, title and editable form fields without a loading indicator; this proves authorized loaded navigation, not task editing/saving. Native date inputs still display mm/dd/yyyy as a separate localization gap.

Opened six original mobile history PNGs. The scrolled outcome captures show succeeded records and the native Task link, with the preceding blocked badge partly hidden by the tab strip; they are not full-history screenshots. Request IDs and ISO dates wrap within390px. Both mobile native Task dialogs show loaded IDs, title, description and native controls without a loading state; lower form sections require vertical scrolling. This is read/navigation evidence only, not task saving. Date-input localization remains different from the Word.

Opened six desktop pending PNGs. The unchecked explicit-review dialog identifies only the selected rule/version/request and disables confirmation; cancel remains visible. Both native Project Task dialogs are fully loaded with task IDs, titles and form controls, not loading placeholders. The selected-only outcome captures show the unselected sibling still pending; the selected result is lower than the captured viewport, so these screenshots alone do not prove its success. Light/dark are distinct and readable. Native date inputs remain mm/dd/yyyy; no task edit/save proof is claimed.

Opened six original mobile pending PNGs. Review dialog wraps at390px with the unchecked confirmation disabled and cancel visible. The selected outcome is Concluida with a native Task link while the preceding sibling retains Reprocessar pendencia; the sibling title/status is above the scrolled viewport, so no complete simultaneous-state screenshot is claimed. Both native Task drawers are loaded with IDs, titles and fields, without loading placeholders; lower fields require vertical scrolling. Light/dark are distinct and readable without horizontal overflow. ISO timestamps and mm/dd/yyyy inputs remain localization differences; native editing/saving is not proven by these captures.
